threat_event: Malicious script on the web checkout overlays the hosted payment fields and captures brand card data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Scripts can reach the checkout through "all pages" tag containers; tamper alerts reviewed weekly in a shared mailbox
existing_controls: Hosted payment fields; March 2026 script inventory; payment page monitoring on the web checkout
treatment_plan: Payment-pages-only container; alerts to the SOC with a 1-hour response; monitoring on the app web view

threat_event: The Rewards Card number and code are captured from the company-hosted field on the checkout page
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Field sits on the retail page outside any payment frame; no owner until 2026-07
existing_controls: TLS to the Financial Services API; same page protections as brand cards
treatment_plan: Isolated Rewards Card payment frame served by Financial Services

threat_event: Memory-scraping malware on legacy lanes at the acquired stores captures card data before encryption is verified
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Flat store networks; POS vendor remote tool outside PAM; password-only back office; late patches
existing_controls: PIN pad encryption; EDR on controllers; store firewalls
treatment_plan: Segment POS VLANs, move vendor access to PAM, MFA for back office, patch within 30 days

threat_event: The legacy store gateway fails or is compromised and the 46 acquired stores cannot authorize cards
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single gateway with no tested failover until migration
existing_controls: Store-and-forward within floor limits
treatment_plan: Warm spare gateway in the secondary data center; failover test

threat_event: About 31,000 full card numbers in acquired settlement exports are copied from the finance file share
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Card numbers stored outside the CDE on a share open to about 400 finance users
existing_controls: Share requires workforce sign-in with MFA
treatment_plan: Delete or truncate within 30 days; quarterly discovery including finance shares

threat_event: Ransomware on store controllers and back office halts checkout across a region
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Store controllers share a management network per region
existing_controls: EDR; offline lane mode; controller images
treatment_plan: Per-store management isolation; controller rebuild drill

threat_event: The payment switch fails in both data centers at once
threat_source: Software defect or shared dependency failure
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Both nodes run the same release
existing_controls: Active-active; staged releases; store-and-forward
treatment_plan: Canary release to one data center first; quarterly dual-site failure drill

threat_event: Overlay skimmers are placed on PIN pads in stores
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Inspection frequency set by a 2024 targeted risk analysis; 46 acquired stores' inspection logs incomplete
existing_controls: Tamper-evident seals; inspection logs; cashier training
treatment_plan: Update the targeted risk analysis; daily inspections at self-checkout

threat_event: EBT card skimming at PIN pads steals SNAP benefits from customers
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: EBT cards rely on magnetic stripe and PIN; same tampering risk as brand cards
existing_controls: PIN pad inspections; tamper-evident seals
treatment_plan: Include EBT in skimming playbooks; coordinate with state EBT processors

threat_event: Credential stuffing takes over customer online accounts
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Customer MFA optional; password reuse
existing_controls: Bot management; breached-password checks
treatment_plan: Risk-based step-up MFA at checkout and for address changes

threat_event: Static payment switch application account passwords are reused by an attacker
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 9 accounts with passwords older than 12 months, not vaulted
existing_controls: Accounts limited to switch hosts; PAM for interactive access
treatment_plan: Vault and rotate all switch application accounts

threat_event: The delivery partner exposes customer order and address data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Partner receives names, addresses, and phone numbers for deliveries
existing_controls: Contract with security terms; SOC 2 report reviewed
treatment_plan: Mask phone numbers through a relay; annual review

threat_event: A store Wi-Fi change bridges the guest network and POS VLANs
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Store network changes made by regional technicians
existing_controls: Central firewall templates; quarterly wireless scans
treatment_plan: Configuration drift alerts on store firewalls

threat_event: Refrigeration controllers are compromised or fail and food is lost
threat_source: Attacker using vendor access; equipment failure
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Controllers on segmented networks except at acquired stores
existing_controls: Local alarms; manual temperature logs
treatment_plan: Move acquired store controllers to OT segments during migration

threat_event: The pricing engine raises prices during a declared emergency or prices unfairly by neighborhood
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No emergency price freeze on online or shelf label prices; neighborhood fairness tests not yet monthly
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-D2 pricing engine; 120 shelf label stores
existing_controls: Price bounds; merchandising review of large changes
treatment_plan: Emergency price freeze; monthly fairness tests (P10)

threat_event: Personalized offers use Rewards Card data for cardholders who opted out of affiliate marketing
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Opt-outs not passed to the CDP; exceptions not documented
existing_controls: Intercompany data agreement
treatment_plan: Daily opt-out suppression; exception rules by campaign

threat_event: Self-checkout video analytics wrongly flag customers for missed scans
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Alerts go to associates without guidance on how to approach customers
existing_controls: No facial recognition; alerts limited to the transaction
treatment_plan: Associate scripts; false positive monitoring by store (P10)

threat_event: A volumetric attack slows the storefront during a holiday peak
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Peaks raise the cost of any slowdown
existing_controls: CDN and WAF; autoscaling
treatment_plan: Accepted by the Grocery Retail CISO (Low); existing controls sufficient

threat_event: The release pipeline is compromised and malicious code reaches the storefront
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Third-party packages in builds
existing_controls: Signed builds; dependency scanning; peer review
treatment_plan: Software bill of materials for every release

threat_event: A store manager uses refunds to cash out stolen value
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Refund limits set per store
existing_controls: Refund approval above limits; exception reports
treatment_plan: Analytics on refund patterns by store

threat_event: A handheld order-picking device with customer order data is lost
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Devices hold the day's pick lists
existing_controls: Device management with remote wipe; no card data
treatment_plan: Accepted by the Grocery Retail CISO (Low)

threat_event: A known vulnerability on an acquired store lane is exploited before it is patched
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Critical patches averaged 74 days at the acquired stores
existing_controls: Quarterly scans
treatment_plan: Patch within 30 days; temporary compensating isolation

threat_event: An intrusion at an acquired store goes unseen because its logs are not in the SIEM
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Weekly manual review of acquired store logs
existing_controls: Weekly manual review
treatment_plan: Onboard all acquired store controllers and the gateway

threat_event: A script vendor outside service provider oversight is compromised
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Tag vendor and 6 script vendors not on the TPSP list; no responsibility matrix entries
existing_controls: Contracts for 4 of the 7 vendors
treatment_plan: Add vendors to the TPSP list; remove vendors that will not accept terms

threat_event: A price file error charges customers more at the register than the shelf price
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Nightly file changes thousands of items
existing_controls: Price file validation; store price audits
treatment_plan: Automated comparison of shelf label and register prices

threat_event: A hurricane closes Florida stores for several days
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 214 of 380 stores are in Florida
existing_controls: Generators; hurricane plan; store-and-forward
treatment_plan: Joint exercise with wholesale each May

threat_event: A POS update prints more card digits than FACTA allows on receipts
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Receipt templates change with POS releases
existing_controls: Receipt checks in release testing
treatment_plan: Automated receipt test for every release

threat_event: The generative AI shopping assistant reveals another customer's order details after a prompt injection
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Assistant can look up orders for signed-in customers
existing_controls: Assistant limited to the signed-in customer's orders
treatment_plan: Red-team testing before each release (P10)
